verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas documents programmatic routes that could drive multi-item changes: an Editor API for automating scene manipulation and asset management, an official Editor MCP server that lets AI assistants modify project data, a REST API, and the SplatTransform CLI that filters, merges and transforms splat data. None of the evidence shows a first-class bulk or batch operation, such as multi-entity edits or batch asset updates, so bulk work is only implied through scripting. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch operation capability in the Editor, API, MCP or REST docs, documented multi-item operation examples, and hands-on or independent corroboration of bulk edits.
